intro.heading: Discover the Mediterranean in Six-Star Luxury
paragraphs: The Mediterranean has captivated travelers for centuries with its ancient civilizations, picturesque coastal villages, world-famous cuisine, and crystal-clear waters. A Scenic Mediterranean Cruise combines these unforgettable destinations with the exceptional luxury of Scenic's Discovery Yachts, creating a truly immersive travel experience.

Unlike larger cruise ships that often focus on crowded ports and rigid schedules, Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II provide an intimate yacht-style atmosphere, allowing guests to explore iconic cities and hidden gems while enjoying six-star accommodations, personalized service, and nearly all-inclusive luxury.

Whether you're strolling through the charming streets of Dubrovnik, enjoying wine in Tuscany, exploring ancient Greek ruins, or relaxing on the French Riviera, Scenic delivers one of the most refined Mediterranean cruise experiences available.

items.title: Spring (April–May)
items.desc: Comfortable temperatures, blooming coastal landscapes, lush scenery, and significantly fewer crowds in popular historic ports.

items.title: Summer (June–August)
items.desc: Warm sunny weather, lively coastal towns, vibrant beach destinations, and long Mediterranean daylight hours.

items.title: Fall (September–October)
items.desc: Pleasant sea temperatures, excellent regional wine harvests, quieter historic centers, and ideal sightseeing conditions.

faqs.question: Where do Scenic Mediterranean Cruises sail?
faqs.answer: Scenic sails throughout the Mediterranean, including Italy, Greece, Croatia, France, Spain, Montenegro, Malta, and Portugal on select itineraries.

faqs.question: Which ships sail the Mediterranean?
faqs.answer: Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II both operate luxury Mediterranean voyages.

faqs.question: Are Scenic Mediterranean Cruises all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most voyages include luxury accommodations, butler service, dining, premium beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities, and many shore excursions.

faqs.question: Does every suite include butler service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every suite aboard Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II includes personalized butler service.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes Scenic Freechoice excursions and Scenic Enrich experiences on many Mediterranean itineraries.

faqs.question: What dining options are available?
faqs.answer: Guests enjoy multiple restaurants serving Mediterranean specialties, international cuisine, fresh seafood, and premium wines.

faqs.question: What is the best time to cruise the Mediterranean?
faqs.answer: Spring (April–May) and Fall (September–October) offer pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and excellent sightseeing opportunities.

faqs.question: Is Scenic suitable for first-time Mediterranean cruisers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Scenic's all-inclusive experience and personalized service make it ideal for first-time luxury cruisers.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included throughout most Scenic Mediterranean cruises.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes onboard gratuities in the cruise fare.

faqs.question: How many guests do Scenic Discovery Yachts accommodate?
faqs.answer: Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II accommodate approximately 228 guests, creating an intimate luxury yacht atmosphere.

faqs.question: Why choose Scenic over larger cruise ships?
faqs.answer: Scenic offers a more personalized experience with spacious suites, butler service, fewer guests, immersive excursions, and nearly all-inclusive luxury, making it ideal for travelers seeking a refined Mediterranean journey.
